metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Dashboard (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: RTT • Regime • Measures • Paradox • Consent • Substrate • Lineage
metadata.description: Defines the non-authoritative dashboard projection for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Dashboard is a projection only; authoritative values come from session.state, alignments, context, and log.

projection_rules: Dashboard MUST NOT contradict authoritative session.state.json.
Dashboard MUST NOT invent measure values.
Dashboard MUST NOT invent paradox types.
Dashboard MUST NOT invent substrate classes.
rtt_rules: rtt_node MUST be one of RTT1–RTT12.
RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
regime_rules: Regime MUST be nominal, harmonic, or resolution.
Regime MUST match rtt_node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.
consent_rules: If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.

non_claims: Dashboard does not revise RTT v0.9.
Dashboard does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Dashboard does not replace the human FFT book.
